entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart pods entered CrashLoopBackOff due to OOMKilled, causing the cart service to be unavailable.
entities.evidence: Alert KubePodCrashLoopBackOff on cart pods, OOMKilled events, high memory usage metric, error logs from cart deployment.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/cart
entities.reasoning: Service endpoint failed because its backing pods were crashing.
entities.evidence: Service had no ready endpoints, observed by alert KubeServiceUnreachable and traces showing failed calls.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend received 5xx errors when calling cart service, degrading user experience.
entities.evidence: Trace error tree shows increased latency and errors from frontend -> cart, alert KubePodHigh5xx on frontend pods.

propagations.condition: Frontend calls cart and receives connection errors

alerts_explained.explanation: Pods of cart deployment repeatedly failed to start due to OOMKilled, triggering CrashLoopBackOff.
Memory usage exceeded container limits on cart pods, causing OOM termination.
Cart service had no ready endpoints because its pods were down.
Frontend pods returned many 5xx responses caused by downstream cart failures.
